author: capfedhill
body:
Until Anguish 20 or so, Celestial Bow or Greatbow are the best.

After Anguish 20 or so, Finesse's Katana and Beguiled Blade X/Y are the premier raid weapons for Realmshifter.

I think Wyrmquill Ballista is pretty decent too but haven't played around with that yet.

author: Danisaski
body: Also upgrade to an *Arisen* Trevelyan Charm

author: skratch
body: T10 my goto for raids is a realmshifter corvus with an arisen nagamaki - the slice attack does more base damage than AoE attacks like envy or kings rage, about double the base attack. the bleed immunity from it is basically is the last DoT type thing I need immunity from so I can redline and just spam slice without having to think/pause to check for DoT debuffs
